T1.decision: Use the complete row-side scaling selection from equations (3.1)-(3.4a): construct the power-of-two diagonal factors at the format-derived threshold and prove the exact scaled-row maximum interval.

T2.decision: Use equation (3.13): the complete exact input-conversion rounding and underflow bound for the scaled inner product (3.3).

T3.decision: Use Theorem 4.1: the actual fixed round-to-nearest scaled p-word computation (4.29)-(4.31), with multiplication and addition rounded in the accumulation format, satisfies (4.32) from the pre-theorem Section 4 estimates. Also formalize the (4.33) envelope difference and the post-(4.33) order-u^(p-1) comparison.

selection_policy: Represent an undefined first-order lesssim by an explicit second-order remainder instead of silently replacing it with an exact displayed inequality.
Represent input and accumulation underflow contributions separately.
Do not promote experimental curves, qualified expectations, or future generalizations to theorem targets.
Keep every public definition free of NumStability imports.
Assign tiers only from the 24 modules in metadata/library_olean.json.
